Name: Mastery Extended
Author: AlanBF
Description:
Mastery Extended is a mod for Stardew Valley that aims to allow the player more options to use the Mastery system.

[size=4][b]Gaining Mastery Points[/b][/size]

You can gain Mastery Points in the same way than in vanilla Stardew, but now you can start gaining them after you get level 10 in the corresponding skill, not only after getting level 10 in all of them.

[size=4][b]Accessing the Mastery Cave[/b][/size]

Other than the normal method, you can also get access if you get to Mastery Level 5 (*configurable*).

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AlanBF1992/MasteryExtended/master/docs/images/mastery-access.png[/img]

After getting access to the Mastery Cave, you can click on the pedestal to show the menu

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AlanBF1992/MasteryExtended/master/docs/images/pedestal-invest.png[/img]

Clicking the "Invest" button will show you the Skills Menu.

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AlanBF1992/MasteryExtended/master/docs/images/skill-menu.png[/img]

Clicking on one of the Skills will show you the Professions for that Skill.

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AlanBF1992/MasteryExtended/master/docs/images/professions-menu.png[/img]
Clicking on a Profession will add it to your character.

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AlanBF1992/MasteryExtended/master/docs/images/profession-added.png[/img]

[size=4][b]Claiming Mastery Pillar Rewards[/b][/size]

You can't unlock them immediately as before. Now you need 3 professions in the Skill, so unlock at least one extra at the Pedestal. (configurable)

[size=4][b]Config[/b][/size]
Hint: You should really use GMCM.
After the first run, there will be a `config.json` file in the mod folder. You can edit the following settings:
[list]
[*][b]MasteryExpPerLevel[/b]: Amount of experience points required for an extra Mastery Level after level 5. Default `30000`.[/*]
[*][b]MasteryCaveAlternateOpening[/b]: If you can access the Mastery Cave with Mastery Levels. Default `true`.[/*]
[*][b]MasteryRequiredForCave[/b]: Mastery Levels required to access the Mastery Cave (if enabled). Default `5`.[/*]
[*][b]SkillNameOnMenuHover[/b]: Show the Skill Name when hovering on Professions in the Skill Menu. Default `true`.[/*]
[*][b]PillarsVsProfessions[/b]: How Professions and Pillars interact. Default `Professions required for Pillars`. Other options: `Pillars required for Pedestal`, `Neither`.
[list]
[*]`[i]Professions required for Pillars[/i]`: You need a certain amount of professions in a skill to unlock the pillar.[/*]
[*]`[i]Pillars required for Pedestal[/i]`: You need to unlock a certain amount of Mastery Pillars to be able to unlock professions.[/*]
[*]`[i]Neither[/i]`: You can unlock pillars and professions independently.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]RequiredProfessionForPillars[/b]: How many professions you need unlocked for the Mastery Pillar. Default `3`.[/*]
[*][b]RequiredPilarsToThePedestal[/b]: How many Mastery Pillar you need unlocked to unlock professions. Default `3`.[/*]
[/list]
[size=2][b]WoL/VPP Config[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]MasteryPercentage[/b]: When you are between level 10 and 19, this percentage of Experience will go to Mastery Exp and the rest to the Skill Exp. Default `20`.[/*]
[/list]
If you don't want to share exp, just set it to 0.

[size=2][b]VPP Config[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Lvl10ProfessionsRequired[/b]: How many Level 10 Professions you need to be able to unlock a Level 15 Profession. Default `2`.[/*]
[*][b]Lvl15ProfessionsRequired[/b]: How many Level 15 Professions you need to be able to unlock a Level 20 Profession. Default `4`.[/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Plans[/b][/size]

[*]Bug Fixing[/*]
[*]Compatibility Fixes?[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]SMAPI Commands[/b][/size]
If you need to fix things
[list]
[*][b]masteryExtended_RecountUsed[/b]: Recounts the player's Mastery Level Used.[/*]
[*][b]masteryExtended_ResetExp[/b]: Sets the Mastery Exp to the minimum possible.[/*]
[*][b]masteryExtended_ResetProfessions[/b]: Reset Vanilla Professions when you sleep.[/*]
[*][b]masteryExtended_ResetProfessionsSpaceCore[/b]: Reset SpaceCore Professions when you sleep.[/*]
[*][b]masteryExtended_AddMasteryLevel <value>[/b]: Add Mastery Levels. <value> is an optional argument.[/*]
[/list]
